parameters.name: ClusterName
parameters.description: The name of the proxy cluster. You can view the proxy cluster name in the console.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page when paging is used.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page when paging is used.

parameters.name: ProxyUuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the proxy node. You can call the DescribeHybridProxyList operation to obtain this value.

parameters.name: Uuid
parameters.description: The unique key of the Security Center agent. You can call an asset query operation to obtain the UUID of the Security Center agent installed on the server.
